text: {"lessons":["I can be patient: my account rose in the first three periods without trades, so I should trade only when there is a clear reason.","Selling 20 shares of Stock B at a gain realized a profit, but one successful sale does not prove I can reliably time the market; I should base decisions on a plan, not recent gains.","My account fell 3.9% after I bought across several stocks, then recovered while I held; I should expect short-term swings, manage position sizes, and keep my apartment goal in view."]}
